description: Cal-ITP Product Services is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. Throughout California, this detailed map show what government agencies have adopted Cal-ITP products services to show to California leadership. Cal-ITP products include; GTFS-rt, contactless-payments, Benefits, Remix, GTFS Data QualityAll records show the agencies headquarters as a icon, and the products they have adopted from Cal-ITP. There are three overlays that can used. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are Government, Railroad, Rail. The bounding box given is -124.1928,32.7058,-72.6494,42.0276. The hub shows 2026-02-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is This is available to the public.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-caltrans-gis-data-hub.
